verdict.rationale: Phaser does ship an official CLI (via npm) that scaffolds projects from templates, but the docs describe it purely as an interactive human-facing prompt tool, not designed for AI-native/agentic automation (no scriptable/non-interactive mode, no flags for programmatic use). The AI-agent story is instead served by a separate MCP server product, which is a different mechanism than a CLI. Missing for 10: evidence of non-interactive/scriptable CLI usage, JSON/structured output for automation, or explicit AI-agent CLI integration.
